subject: Accelerated MAP & discount request — Clearmode
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearmode.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Jana Myers <jana.myers@clearmode.ai>, Clearmode Procurement <procurement@clearmode.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Accelerated MAP proposal + pricing ask

Hi Soojin —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We liked the latency profile and the KV cache examples — this would materially help our real-time summarization use case. We discussed an accelerated MAP internally and would like to propose a three-month evaluation plan with the following milestones: 

- Month 1: Pilot + integration (up to 50k tokens/day)
- Month 2: Ramp to 250k tokens/day; embedded search proof of value
- Month 3: Production roll-in across two product lines (commit to SLOs)

Clearmode is prepared to commit to a minimum $200k ARR if Redwood can accommodate a 25% introductory discount on hosted API/token pricing for the first 6 months. The discount is the gating item for procurement approval and an expedited legal review.

Attached is our MAP draft (Clearmode_MAP_v2.pdf) and a short SOW outline. Can you confirm internal approval path and whether finance can sign off on the proposed discount? We’d like to close by Sep 10 to align with our quarter planning.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Director, Applied ML
Clearmode Analytics

Attachments: Clearmode_MAP_v2.pdf (PDF, 248KB), SOW_draft_v1.docx (DOCX, 34KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearmode.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerated MAP proposal + pricing ask

Hi Alyssa —

Really appreciate the clear milestones — this is the kind of MAP that helps us enable a fast, measured pilot. I’ve looped Marissa and Ben on the thread to get pricing/discount confirmation and to pull together a short mutual action plan and updated SOW.

Proposed next steps:
- Internal pricing review (we’ll aim to confirm discount policy by EOD Sep 3)
- Architecture call Sep 3 to lock integration checkpoints (I’ll send a calendar invite)
- If pricing approved, we’ll send an SOW + DocuSign for a 6-month introductory term with milestone-based credits.

I’m attaching the MAP you sent and a first-pass checklist. Talk tomorrow —

– Soojin
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Accelerated MAP proposal + pricing ask — request for discount approval (Clearmode DL-89234)

Folks — forwarding Clearmode’s MAP and SOW. Quick summary and ask below so this isn’t buried: 

Summary:
- Account: Clearmode Analytics (Applied ML product)
- Deal: DL-89234; potential committed ARR $200k with 6-month intro promo
- Customer request: 25% introductory discount across hosted token pricing for first 6 months
- Timeline: wants to close by Sep 10 to meet internal procurement cycles; pilot call scheduled for Sep 3

Why this is time-sensitive:
- Procurement at Clearmode requires a price point to start their legal review; delaying pricing pushes their internal Q planning
- Rapid integration is feasible, but discount affects unit economics — finance needs to bless the structure and any ramp/commitments

Recommended structure (my proposal):
- Approve up to 22% one-time introductory discount if Clearmode commits to $200k ARR and signed SOW with milestone KPIs (detailed in attached)
- Include staged rebates (credits) for missing ramp milestones rather than retroactive refunds

Ask:
- Can Marissa/Ben confirm commercial support for 22%? Anything above 20% requires finance sign-off (Laura). If you think we need >22%, please advise and I’ll escalate.

I’ve attached the MAP + SOW draft and a short pricing worksheet. Please reply with yes/no and any edits; need decision by EOD Sep 7 to stay on their timeline.

Thanks —
Sooj

Attachments: Clearmode_MAP_v2.pdf, SOW_draft_v1.docx, pricing_workbook_clearmode.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Accelerated MAP proposal + pricing ask — request for discount approval (Clearmode DL-89234)

Thanks for the summary, Soojin.

I support a commercial concession to help close quickly. A few practical notes: 
- Standard play: discounts above 20% require Finance (Laura) and Exec (Aditya) visibility.
- Counter-proposal we can offer immediately: 20% off + performance credits tied to Month 2 ramp; if they hit the stated tokens/day, we issue a 5% rebate applied month 4–6 (effectively 25% upside but contingent).
- If we go straight to a 25% guaranteed discount we need LAURA to sign and a short memo to the CEO for awareness.

I’m fine with the 22% proposal if Finance signs off; it’s defensible given the ARR commitment and reduced tenure risk.

Ben
VP Sales (West)
Redwood Inference

> On Thu, Sep 2, 2027 at 08:45 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Escalation: 22% introductory discount request for Clearmode (DL-89234) — decision needed by EOD

Laura/Aditya —

Quick escalation: Clearmode is requesting a 25% introductory discount to commit $200k ARR and expedite procurement. The account team recommends approving up to 22% contingent on a signed SOW with milestone KPIs and a 6-month introductory term. Ben supports this approach (thread below).

Why this matters:
- If we do not get pricing to them by Sep 10 they will postpone legal and push decision into next quarter, increasing churn risk for this opportunity.
- The deal has strategic value: Clearmode is in a vertical with multiple co-sell possibilities and could grow materially.

Proposed guardrails for approval at 22%:
- Signed SOW with explicit milestone KPIs and ramp schedule
- Quarterly measurement and credit-based rebates for missed ramp (no retroactive cash refunds)
- Exec visibility and a one-off exception logged in the commercial exceptions tracker

Attached: condensed rationale memo + pricing workbook. Can you please confirm Approve / Approve with edits / Decline by EOD Sep 7 so we can respond to the customer?

Thanks —
Soojin
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_workbook_clearmode.xlsx, Clearmode_MAP_v2.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: 22% introductory discount request for Clearmode (DL-89234) — decision needed by EOD

Soojin/Ben/Team —

I reviewed the pricing workbook and the proposed guardrails. I will approve a one-time 22% introductory discount under the following conditions: 

1) Clearmode signs the SOW with the milestone KPIs as written (Month 1 integration, Month 2 ramp to 250k tokens/day, Month 3 production roll-in).
2) The SOW contains staged credits (not cash refunds) tied to the ramp milestones and a clawback if customer materially misses commitment after month 6.
3) Sales documents the commercial exception with rationale and expected upside in the exceptions tracker and notifies the legal lead for expedited review.

Conditional approval granted. Please implement the credits structure in the SOW and share the final DocuSign link.

Laura Bennett
VP Finance (interim CFO)
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: 22% introductory discount request for Clearmode (DL-89234) — decision needed by EOD

Thanks team — I’ve reviewed and I’m comfortable with the 22% conditional approval. Prioritize the SOW changes Laura outlined and get legal to fast-track. Keep me posted if procurement pushes on term length.

Aditya Rao
CEO, Redwood Inference
